headline: J-pop group 2xFE make Korean debut with '2:07'
sub: BIGBANG fans at heart: "We admire BIGBANG"

points.title: What to know
items: They write, choreograph and make their outfits
Name stands for 'Future from East End'
Goals: regular Korean shows, K-pop collabs

source: Source: Segye Ilbo, Topstar News (Korean media)
caption:
Japanese boy group 2xFE have officially debuted in Korea with the single '2:07' (2시 7분).

The four-member group, who debuted in Japan in 2023, held a showcase at Rolling Hall in Hongdae on Nov 23. RIO said the title came from the time on his phone while they were writing the song. SUNN said he has loved K-pop since childhood and admires BIGBANG, recalling being blown away by 'Fantastic Baby' in fifth grade. Catch their first Korean busking show at Sinchon Star Plaza on Nov 24, 8 PM KST.

📌 Source: Segye Ilbo, Topstar News, via Korean media
